@marcorubio I think you were touched by a priest and the rest of us are dealing with you repressing it.

I was ashamed of what happened to me too (not by a priest), Marco, but I didn't resort to destroying the world over it. I'm trying to end suffering of others due to my suffering. #MeToo

Notice *anything* at all different about the way the #DCPolice are treating these protesters compared to the #BLM protesters earlier in the year?

You 'memba? Yeah, I 'memba.

Hint: no tear gas, rubber bullets, bashed in skulls, batons, vehicle assaults, etc.

So much for Blue Lives Matter, huh Proud Boys?

They only like the cops when they're ganging up on #BLM protesters. It has nothing to do with the Constitution. #BlackLivesMatter

I'll never trust U.S. politics again after passing on the best chance we had at real reform in my lifetime.

I won't live to see another opportunity like the one Establishment @TheDemocrats fought so hard against.

This system may not survive another century with #ClimateCrisis.

As far as I'm concerned, only survivors can rightfully speak on behalf of #MeToo and then only for purposes that edify survivors and condem culprits.

No political theater.

For you political hacks and wannabe activists, shut up and let the people who know the trauma speak on it.

@CPCJuiceBox @CarlaRK3 @SocialistMMA @Alyssa_Milano @SymoneDSanders BOTH of whom have blocked this #MeToo survivor for questioning their motives in the movement, given their support of Biden.

They don't support survivors, they create victims.

I was wondering what topic would be replayed this #GroundhogDay.

I didn't have, "Explaining the takeover of the #MeToo movement by neoliberal Establishment figurehead celebrities who don't support survivors but create victims," as my February 2nd laylong loop.
Blue Lives Matter is a racist slogan meant to mock and diminish #BlackLivesMatter.

Reminder to "All Lives Matter" advocates:

ALL lives can't matter until ALL lives actually matter.

So until #BlackLivesMatter, it's impossible to say ALL lives matter.

We shouldn't be anxious over the sheep huddled safely with the flock but the ones left behind in danger.

I can't believe just how many racists HAVE to stop by to defend their racists "All Lives Matter" slogan, created to mock and further marginalize the #BlackLivesMatter movement.

They aren't happy, unless everyone knows just how ignorant they are.

Come join the 'fun'.
